book.name: MARK
book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MARK

content: Sises Kakehlahda Ohl emen me Ngehn Saut Tiada Powe
Sises oh sapwellime tohnpadahk ko eri kotehla Lehen Kalilio douluhllahng palio, nan sapwen mehn Kerasa.
Sises ketin keredihsangete pohn pwohto, a iet ohl emen me ngehn saut tiadahr powe pa kohkodohng reh; e kohdo sang nan sousou kei, wasa e kin koukousoan ie.
Sohte aramas emen kakohng ohlo, pil selmete kan sohte kak salihedi;
pwe pak tohto e selkihdi selmete ni peh oh neh kan, e ahpw kin kamweidpeseng selmete ko; sohte me kak koledi pwehki eh kehlail.
Ni rahn nipwong, e kin kakahnseli nan sousou kan, oh nanwel en pohn nahna kan, wie weriwer kalipwelipwehki paliwere takai keng kan.
Eri, e kilangadahte Sises sang wasa doh, e ahpw tenge, poaridiong mwowe,
weriwer, ndinda, “Maing Sises, Sapwellimen Koht Lapalahpie! Dahme komw ketin kupwukupwurehiong ie? Ni mwaren Koht, komw dehr ketin kalokei ie!”
(E ndinda met pwehki Sises eh ketin mahmahsanihong, “Kowe ngehn saut, kohkohieisang rehn aramas menen!”)
Sises eri keinemwe reh, mahsanih, “Ia mwaromw?” A ohlo sapeng, patohwanohng, “Ih mwarei, ‘Karis,’ pwe se me tohto!”
E ahpw ngidingidkihong Sises en dehr ketin kausasang ngehn saut ako nan sahpweo.
A limwahn wasao, pelin pwihk ehu mihmi ie, wie mwengemwenge ni keilen dohl ehu.
Ngehn saut ako eri pekihda rehn Sises en kadarihrala oh mweidohng re en kolahng dillong rehn pwihk ko.

Sises eri ketin mweidohng. Ngehn saut ako eri kohieisang rehn ohlo, oh uhd kohla dillong rehn pwihk ko. Pelin pwihko, me wadeparail kereniong riekid, ahpw wiahkihteieu pwururda oh tangdiong nan leho, wasa irail koaros duhla oh mwopwula.
Silepen pwihk ko ahpw tangdoaui oh kohla nan kahnimwo oh nan sahpwo, kairehkiseli aramas akan duwen me wiawihero. Aramas akan eri kohieila pwe re en kilang dahme wiawiher.

Ni ar lel wasa Sises ketiket ieo, re pwuriamweikihla mehlel ar kilangada ohl me tehnwar en ngehn suwed ko mahso, eh mwomwohd wasao meleilei, miher nan likou mwahu oh mwomwen aramas mwahu mehlel. Re ahpw mwur masakada.
A irail ko me kadehdehki masarail ko manamano, re ahpw ndaiong irail dahme wiawihong tehnwar en ngehn suwed ko, oh pil duwen pwihk ko.
Irail eri pekihda Sises en ketiketla sang nan sapwarailo.
Ni Sises eh ketidahng pohn pwohto, me tehnwar en ngehn suwed ko ahpw pekihda reh, patohwanohng, “Komw ketin mweidohng ie pwe I en iangkomwihwei!”

Sises ahpw sohte ketin mweidohng, pwe e mahsanihong, “Kohkohla ni imwomwo, rehn omw peneinei kan, oh kairehkin irail duwen manaman lapalap me Kaun-o ketin wiahiong uhk, oh duwen eh kupwurkalahngan ong uhk.”
Ohlo eri kohlahte lohkiseli nan wehin Dekapolis
manaman lapalap me Sises ketin wiahiong; a koaros me rong met re ahpw pwuriamweikihla kowahlap.
Sises Kakehlahda nein Sairus Serepein oh pil Lih Soumwahu men
Sises ketin pwurehng kotehla leho ketila palio. Pokon kalaimwun ehu ahpw pil kohpene oh kapilpene ni oaroahro.
A soumas emen en sinakokeo, ede Sairus, ahpw lel reh, poaridiong ni aluweluwe kan,
ngidingidki eh pekipek, patohwan, “Maing, ei tungoal kisin serepein kis kereniongehr mehla. Komw ketin kupwur mahk oh ketila ketikidahng limomwi kan powe, pwe en kehlailda oh kak mour!”
Sises eri ketida oh ketin iangala soumaso. A pokon kalaimwuno ahpw pil idawehnla, wasa koaros nanialo ahpw koaitla.
Lih emen pil iang mi wasao, me kohkohwahki mehn warmwowi erein sounpar eisek riau.
E ahpw reperepen mour rehn sounwini tohto oh kesehkilahr nah mwohni kan koaros, ahpw sohte katepe, pwe e susuwedlahte.
Ni liho eh rongada duwen Sises sang rehn aramas akan, e ahpw keilahng pohnpelikie;
pwe e mengimengloalki, “Ma ihte sapwellime likou me I pahn doahke, I uhdahn pahn kehlailda.”
Eri, e ahpw doahke sapwellimen Sises likowo, oh ni ahnsowohte pwilipwil en nta reh pa madada; liho eri pehmada sang nan paliwereo me e kehlaildahsangehr eh soumwahwo.
Ni ahnsowohte Sises ketin pehmada duwen kisin roson kis eh kohsang reh, e ahpw ketin sohpeiseli nan pokono, oh mahsanih, “Ihs me doahke ei likowet?”
Sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw patohwanohng, “Komw ketin mahsanih duwen pokonet eh koaitonkomwilahr, a komw keinemwe, ‘Ihs me doahkei ie?’”
Ih eri ketin mahsenseli pohn pokono, pwe en mahsanih ihs me wiahda meo.
A liho, nan eh ese dahme wiawihong, e ahpw masepwehkada, rerrer, keiong mpe, poaridiong mwohn aluweluwe kan, patohwanohng Sises mehkoaros.
Sises eri mahsanihong liho, “Nei serepein, omw pwoson me kakehleiukada. Eri, kohkohwei ni popohl, pwe ke kehlaildahsangehr omw soumwahwen.”
Nindokon eh ketin mahmahsen, pakair ehu pa lel rehn Sairus sang ni imweo, me ketihtihki, “Noumwi serepeino melahr; komw dehr kangirehki Sounpadahken en ketido.”
Sises sohte ketin tehk; e ahpw mahsanihong Sairus, “Komw dehr masak mehkot, komw pwosonte.”
E ahpw sohte mweidohng mehmen en iangala, ihte Piter, Seims oh rie Sohn.
Ni ar lel ni imwen soumaso, e ahpw mahsanihada duwen ar mwoaromwoarong oh mwahmwahiei kowahlap.
Ih eri ketilong oh mahsanihong irail, “Dahme kumwail mwoaromwoarong oh mwahmwahieiki? Serien sohte mehla, e wie memeir!”

Irail ahpw kepikepitki oh kokouruhrki. Eri, e ahpw ketin kapedoisang irail koaros nan ihmwo, oh mwuri, e ketin ukehda semen serio oh ine, oh pil sapwellime tohnpadahk silimeno, e ahpw ketilong wasa me serio wonohn ie.
E ahpw ketin kolada peho oh mahsanihong, “Dalida koum,” me wehwehki, “Serepein, pwourda!”
Eri, ni ahnsowohte serepeino ahpw pwourda oh tapihada alialuseli. (E sounpar eisek riau.) Irail inenen pwuriamweikihla wiewia wet.
Sises eri ketin kalikiraildi re dehpa ndaseli mewet; e ahpw mahsanihong irail re en kamwenge serepeino.
